6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: As I stood in the Benievon Archsanctuary, I marveled at the Lake of Reflection. Its waters flowed through naturally formed channels, weaving through the sanctuary's heart.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: As I stood in the Benievon Archsanctuary, I marveled at the Lake of Reflection. Its waters flowed through naturally formed channels, weaving through the sanctuary's heart.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: The Archsanctuary had been constructed around these canals, incorporating their presence in its design.

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: As I knelt at the water's edge, my gaze fixed upon the mirrored surface, hoping for clarity amidst the echoes of protests resounding incessantly within my mind.

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: Even in this oasis of calm, I could find no respite from the turmoil that plagued my realm.

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: With a furrowed brow, I attempted to silence the internal clamor, but the tumult of voices only grew louder -- perhaps a trial of faith in itself.

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: My voice echoed through the grand hall, though it was only meant for the empty air.

21.speaker: Narrator
21.text: I turned and faced the Grand Wiseman, who I hadn't heard enter.

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: "Forgive me, Grand Wiseman. I didn't hear you come in."

23.speaker: Player_Romus
23.text: "For God's sake, don't sneak up on me like that!"

24.speaker: Player_Romus
24.text: "I wasn't referring to you, Grand Wiseman, but rather to the shouts of protests spreading across the kingdom."

25.speaker: Narrator
25.text: It was then that I noticed Sal standing nearby. With a gentle grace, he retrieved the fallen chalice and approached, holding it out to me.

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "May God forgive me for that outburst."

30.speaker: Sal Ignacius
30.text: "Forgive me, Your Majesty. I thought you heard me come in."

31.speaker: Sal Ignacius
31.text: "If you don't mind my asking, what seems to be the trouble?"

33.speaker: Narrator
33.text: Sal waited a moment before setting the chalice down on a nearby altar.

36.speaker: Sal Ignacius
36.text: "There you are, Your Majesty. I was looking for you."

43.speaker: Sal Ignacius
43.text: "I came to inform you that the ceremony is set to begin within the hour, so we'll need to start letting people into the Archsanctuary soon."

44.speaker: Narrator
44.text: He was referring to the graduation of the latest batch of Wruhec's Guardians cadets.

45.speaker: Narrator
45.text: Despite the Board of Trustees' initial resistance, they eventually committed to incorporating the Guardians' doctrine into the school's standard curriculum.

46.speaker: Narrator
46.text: Thus, the ceremony provided a convenient excuse for my visit to Benievon amidst the unrest in Porte Drazon.

50.speaker: Player_Romus
50.text: "Sorry, I lost my temper. I've got a lot on my mind."

51.speaker: Sal Ignacius
51.text: "No need to apologize, Your Majesty. I can only imagine the pressure you're under."

55.speaker: Narrator
55.text: With a furrowed brow, I attempted to silence the internal clamor, but the tumult of voices only grew louder.

59.speaker: Narrator
59.text: As I knelt at the water's edge, my gaze fixed upon the mirrored surface. Its serenity stood in quiet defiance to the echoes of protests resounding incessantly within my mind.

60.speaker: Player_Romus
60.text: "Forgive me. I didn't hear you come in."

61.speaker: Player_Romus
61.text: "And what do I owe the pleasure, Grand Wiseman?"

66.speaker: Sal Ignacius
66.text: "I just wanted to inform you that the ceremony is set to begin within the hour, so we'll need to start letting people into the Archsanctuary soon."

69.speaker: Sal Ignacius
69.text: "My apologies. I didn't mean to startle you."

70.speaker: Narrator
70.text: My newly established religious security force was headquartered at the nearby Benievon Academy, a prestigious institution renowned for catering to the noble and elite class of Rizia.

71.speaker: Player_Romus
71.text: "You must have noticed the unrest in our kingdom. I fear Rizia is on the verge of an uprising once more."

72.speaker: Player_Romus
72.text: "I'm troubled by the seemingly endless stream of issues plaguing our nation."

74.speaker: Sal Ignacius
74.text: "Very well. I won't press the issue."

75.speaker: Sal Ignacius
75.text: "Ah, yes. It saddens me to see our people losing faith in their King."

76.speaker: Sal Ignacius
76.text: "As am I, Your Majesty. It saddens me that our people are losing faith in their King."

77.speaker: Narrator
77.text: The sound of the Archsantuary doors opening drew our attention to the front entrance, where people began trickling inside.

78.speaker: Narrator
78.text: Sal and I stepped away from the main aisle, allowing the flow of individuals to pass without obstruction.

79.speaker: Sal Ignacius
79.text: "Uncertainty breeds turmoil, but faith endures. No matter how restless the times, I believe God will guide us through."

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "I wish I shared your optimism. Just thinking about it makes my head explode."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "Every day, I hope for a peaceful resolution. However, I'm concerned that we may need to consider more assertive measures."

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "These agitators mistake tolerance for weakness. It's a misunderstanding I intend to rectify."

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "Every day, I offer prayers for a peaceful resolution. Yet, I cannot help but fear that more assertive measures may become necessary."

87.speaker: Player_Romus
87.text: "It just feels like we've exhausted all available resources -- that nothing I do ever satisfies them."

88.speaker: Sal Ignacius
88.text: "Your Majesty, while it may seem that way, we mustn't lose hope."

89.speaker: Sal Ignacius
89.text: "Indeed, Your Majesty. Maintaining order and authority is essential."

90.speaker: Sal Ignacius
90.text: "It's normal to feel overwhelmed, but remember, you're never alone. God is always with you."

91.speaker: Sal Ignacius
91.text: "I share your hope for peace, but I also understand your concerns."

92.speaker: Sal Ignacius
92.text: "Even in the darkest hours, there's always a glimmer of hope that the odds, no matter how daunting they may seem, will be overcome."

93.speaker: Sal Ignacius
93.text: "And for what it's worth, you have me, too."

94.speaker: Narrator
94.text: Our attention was drawn to the majestic tones of an organ that resonated throughout the chamber.

96.speaker: Player_Romus
96.text: "Remind me, how long does their training last?"

97.speaker: Player_Romus
97.text: "Why are a select few wearing different uniforms?"

98.speaker: Player_Romus
98.text: "Good to know. We can speak more about them some other time."

111.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
111.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_ReligionMeeting_CadetsHowMany"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_ReligionMeeting_CadetsTraining"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_ReligionMeeting_CadetsUniforms"] == true) == false

112.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
112.text: "There are over 2,500, Your Majesty -- a mere fraction of the cadets enrolled across Rizia."

113.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
113.text: "Those are the elite cadets, Your Majesty, known as 'The Devout.' They are the most dedicated."

114.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
114.text: "Physical fitness and defense training lasts for 10 weeks, followed by an additional 6 weeks of spiritual training, Your Majesty."

115.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
115.text: "Each one has endured a rigorous spiritual experience of seven days and nights, staring into the Lake of Reflection without food or water."

116.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
116.text: "This experience makes them officers and leaders among their peers."

122.speaker: Narrator
122.text: Once the cadets had finished taking their respective seats, the Wiseman of Benievon stepped into the pulpit and began his commencement address.

123.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
123.text: "If I may speak freely... given the civil upheaval we're seeing, I feel there is a solution that's not being used to its full potential."

127.speaker: Narrator
127.text: He gestured subtly to the cadets in front of us.

128.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
128.text: "Wruhec's Guardians. As you know, we've been tasked with faith-based humanitarian work--"

129.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
129.text: "But we could be doing more. Much more."

130.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
130.text: "Perhaps it's time for us to set aside the plowshares and to wield the sword of justice."

131.speaker: Player_Romus
131.text: "Wruhec's Guardians have proven their dedication and capability, and are a force to be reckoned with."

133.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
133.text: "Legally speaking, you have the authority to deploy Wruhec's Guardians to maintain order and uphold God's divine law."

134.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
134.text: "As you are God's representative on earth, earthly laws are no different from godly laws, and vice versa."

135.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
135.text: "Disregard of divine laws is punishable on earth as it is in the eyes of the Almighty."

136.speaker: Player_Romus
136.text: "Ensure that Wruhec's Guardians are given everything they need." [-1 Budget]

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "Are you certain that deploying them to quell unrest is the right course of action?"

138.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
138.text: "Your Majesty, legally speaking, Captain Gordion and I have the authority to deploy Wruhec's Guardians to maintain order."

139.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
139.text: "As the appointed representative of God on earth, you have the power to enforce divine laws."

140.speaker: Player_Romus
140.text: "But using them for such purposes... I worry about public backlash."

141.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
141.text: "I understand your hesitation, but in times of crisis, we must be prepared to take necessary measures."

142.speaker: Player_Romus
142.text: "We must do what is necessary to restore peace and order. See to it that Wruhec's Guardians are prepared for their new duties."

143.speaker: Player_Romus
143.text: "The sword of justice. Are you advocating for violence?"

144.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
144.text: "I am advocating for the restoration of order, so that our kingdom may continue on the path that has been ordained for it."

145.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
145.text: "As the earthly representative of God, you have the legal means to authorize the Guardians to use as much force as necessary."

146.speaker: Player_Romus
146.text: "Yes, but using them for such purposes... It feels like a drastic measure."

147.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
147.text: "I understand your hesitation, Your Majesty. But the situation seems dire to me, and we must consider all available options."

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "I appreciate your perspective, Sevrio. But I'm not inclined to deploy Wruhec's Guardians in this manner."

149.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
149.text: "Understood, Your Majesty. I will ensure that our cadets persist in their current endeavors."

150.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
150.text: "Of course, Your Majesty. I'll ensure the Wruhec's Guardians are prepared to fulfill their new responsibilities."

151.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
151.text: "Yes, Your Majesty. I will see to it that the Wruhec's Guardians are fully prepared to uphold justice and restore order."

152.speaker: Player_Romus
152.text: "And I get that. But just because we *can* deploy them doesn't mean that we should."

153.speaker: Player_Romus
153.text: "No. Deploying Wruhec's Guardians in such a manner will only worsen the problem. We need peaceful solutions."

154.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
154.text: "I fear the time for peace is rapidly coming to an end."

157.speaker: Sal Ignacius
157.text: "Your Majesty... with the formation of the Guardians, we came one step closer to bringing God's will to Rizia. But now I must humbly beg you to take a leap of faith."

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "I don't understand. What is it that you are asking of me?"

159.speaker: Player_Romus
159.text: "I'm on board with implementing theocratic reforms. What would you have me do?"

160.speaker: Player_Romus
160.text: "It's all the same to me. Expressing religious devotion publicly is one thing. But I won't put Wruhecism front and center in government."

161.speaker: Sal Ignacius
161.text: "God be praised! I knew you envisioned this kingdom's future as I do."

162.speaker: Narrator
162.text: As if ordained from heaven, the organ, once again, came to life. Everyone stood and began singing a hymn, their voices reverberating throughout the chamber.

163.speaker: Sal Ignacius
163.text: "Please excuse me, Your Majesty. I must now attend to my duties at the ceremony."

164.speaker: Narrator
164.text: Sal made his way into the congregation, and I observed the procession. Each cadet approached Sal, who reverently collected the holy water from the sacred pool into a chalice from which to drink.

168.speaker: Sal Ignacius
168.text: "Unless you'd like to do it yourself, given your divine appointment as Rizia's spiritual leader."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "It would be my honor. I accept."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "You go ahead. I wouldn't want to deprive you of your sacred duty."

171.speaker: Player_Romus
171.text: "No thanks. But I appreciate the offer."

172.speaker: Player_Romus
172.text: "Of course! Just give me clear instructions on what needs to be done."

173.speaker: Narrator
173.text: Each cadet took their turn to partake in this sacred ritual, a symbol of their commitment and dedication to their faith and kingdom.

174.speaker: Narrator
174.text: He drank, bathed in the kaleidoscopic light from the stained-glass windows.

176.speaker: Narrator
176.text: As I made my way towards the mass of recruits, Sal briefed me on what to do before I joined him in distributing the holy water.

177.speaker: Narrator
177.text: As each individual approached one by one, they did so with reverence, bowing as they neared.

181.speaker: Narrator
181.text: The one I recently threw across the room. Nevertheless...

182.speaker: Narrator
182.text: Every cadet approached to partake in this sacred ritual, symbolizing their commitment and dedication to both their faith and their kingdom.

186.speaker: Narrator
186.text: The one I recently threw across the room. Nevertheless...

188.speaker: Sal Ignacius
188.text: "Nothing less and nothing more than the complete integration of Wruhecism into the Rizian government."

189.speaker: Sal Ignacius
189.text: "It seems our goals are not as in aligned as I thought. If that's the case, I have nothing more to say."

192.speaker: Narrator
192.text: The Grand Wiseman bowed politely before leaving my side as I continued to watch the ceremony.

193.speaker: Narrator
193.text: One motivational speech and several songs later, I observed the procession.

195.speaker: Narrator
195.text: The Archsanctuary had been built around these canals, embracing their presence in its design.

196.speaker: Narrator
196.text: As I knelt at the water's edge, my gaze fixed upon the mirrored surface, hoping to find spiritual clarity as legend said it would provide.

200.speaker: Narrator
200.text: As I knelt at the water's edge, my gaze fixed upon the mirrored surface, and I observed an old man I hardly recognized.

201.speaker: Narrator
201.text: It was then I saw another familiar face in the water's reflection. Grand Wiseman Sal Ignacius.

202.speaker: Narrator
202.text: I had been invited here to witness the results.

206.speaker: Narrator
206.text: Before long, the majestic tones of an organ resonated throughout the chamber.

208.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
208.text: "This represents the third graduating class of the Benievon Academy, the most prestigious among them."

209.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
209.text: "If my memory serves me correctly, your uncle is an alumnus of the Academy. The old version of it, I mean."

219.speaker: Narrator
219.text: He gazed fondly at the cadets before us.

220.speaker: Sal Ignacius
220.text: "During Alignment of the Six Stars, I mentioned my willingness to advise you in a closer capacity. Are you ready to place a Grand Wiseman into the role of Grand Vizier?"

222.speaker: Sal Ignacius
222.text: "Just as your Grand Vizier must be a man of God, so must all your advisors be versed in Wruhecist principles."

223.speaker: Sal Ignacius
223.text: "What do you say, Your Majesty? Shall we walk this path together, as in the stories of old?"

224.speaker: Player_Romus
224.text: "I cannot commit to any of this. You are asking for far too much. Sorry, Sal."

225.speaker: Player_Romus
225.text: "We can meet in the middle. Petition for Grand Vizier when the current Royal Council term ends, and I give you my word I will consider you for the position."

226.speaker: Player_Romus
226.text: "We shall. Rizia will be a holy Wruhecist kingdom, governed by messengers of God."

227.speaker: Sal Ignacius
227.text: "It seems our goals are not as in aligned as I thought. If that's the case, and there's no changing your mind otherwise, I will speak of this no more."

230.speaker: Sal Ignacius
230.text: "Excellent! You have no idea how much this means for me, and for Rizia."

231.speaker: Sal Ignacius
231.text: "I shall begin the preparations for our transformation immediately. Rizia is blessed to have you as our sovereign king."

233.speaker: Sal Ignacius
233.text: "Bless you, Your Majesty! This decision heralds a new era for our kingdom, one where divine guidance illuminates our path forward."

237.speaker: Sal Ignacius
237.text: "It's wise to remain vigilant and consider all options. Even the less peaceful ones."

238.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
238.text: "Wruhec's Guardians can serve as a strong deterrent against further violence and unrest."

239.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
239.text: "We can help maintain stability and prevent further escalation of violence."

240.speaker: Sal Ignacius
240.text: "As Grand Vizier, I can provide invaluable guidance on both state and soul, guaranteeing the prosperity of our realm in worldly matters and in matters of the spirit."

241.speaker: Sal Ignacius
241.text: "I'm to distribute the holy water to the new recruits, the final step to becoming a Wruhec's Guardian."

242.speaker: Narrator
242.text: Each cadet approached Sal, who reverently collected the holy water from the sacred pool into a chalice from which to drink.

243.speaker: Narrator
243.text: Meanwhile, I carefully scooped up the holy water from the sacred pool into a chalice.

245.speaker: Player_Romus
245.text: "At least the two of us still have the Lord on our side."

246.speaker: Player_Romus
246.text: "I didn't realize you were paying that much attention to earthly goings-on."

247.speaker: Player_Romus
247.text: "I trust your spiritual advice, Grand Wiseman. But when it comes to placating the populace, I'd rather consult with my council."

248.speaker: Sal Ignacius
248.text: "As is your right. Just remember that heaven and earth are more closely linked than they appear."

250.speaker: Sal Ignacius
250.text: "I listen to our people, Your Majesty. When they have grievances, it is the Sanctuary whom they turn to first."

251.speaker: Player_Romus
251.text: "Those who go against the Crown will bear the full brunt of my vengeance. End of story."
251.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_GolcondistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false)

256.speaker: Player_Romus
256.text: "I have my doubts about replacing my uncle."

260.speaker: Player_Romus
260.text: "Now that you mention it, the position has been vacant for some time."

261.speaker: Player_Romus
261.text: "I need a new Grand Vizier after my uncle's resignation. But I can't simply appoint you without considering other candidates. There are rules that have to be followed."

262.speaker: Player_Romus
262.text: "Hugo is a religious man himself. What if I were to keep him on?"

263.speaker: Player_Romus
263.text: "I am not opposed to the idea. Your advice has never steered me wrong thus far."

264.speaker: Sal Ignacius
264.text: "You still don't understand, my king. The only rules that matter are God's."

266.speaker: Sal Ignacius
266.text: "You may keep him as an advisor, of course. But for our holy kingdom to succeed, the Grand Vizier position must be filled by a holy servant."

267.speaker: Sal Ignacius
267.text: "It's only natural to have doubts. But listen to what your heart tells you. What the visions have prophesized."

268.speaker: Player_Romus
268.text: "I'm still not convinced this entire scheme isn't a power grab on your part."

269.speaker: Sal Ignacius
269.text: "If I could suggest someone else, I would. But I have spent my life as a conduit between the Crown and the heavens. I can think of no one else more qualified."

270.speaker: Sal Ignacius
270.text: "I have only carried the word of God to your ears, Your Majesty."

271.speaker: Sal Ignacius
271.text: "Next. there is the matter of your so-called Golden Guard."

272.speaker: Sal Ignacius
272.text: "In my eyes, it has never been fitting for the King of Rizia to surround himself with such an obvious symbol of material wealth."

273.speaker: Sal Ignacius
273.text: "All of your guardsmen must shed their golden trappings and become Wruhec's Guardians. I know Captain Gordion will agree with me."

274.speaker: Player_Romus
274.text: "You are asking me to break centuries of Rizian royal tradition."

275.speaker: Sal Ignacius
275.text: "Decades, at most. Don't forget that your grandmother did away with the Golden Guard entirely."

280.speaker: Sal Ignacius
280.text: "Just imagine the members of the expanded Golden Guard working as one with Sevrio and our cadets here. It will be beautiful."

281.speaker: Narrator
281.text: He gestured down at the cadets.

282.speaker: Sal Ignacius
282.text: "I am sure replacements can be arranged."

283.speaker: Player_Romus
283.text: "Yes, that makes sense. I shall be protected by a holy army."

284.speaker: Player_Romus
284.text: "Of course he will. This is what you and he wanted from the beginning, isn't it?"

285.speaker: Sal Ignacius
285.text: "We would never discuss such topics behind your back."

286.speaker: Sal Ignacius
286.text: "But Captain Gordion's reverence for the Divine is obvious. With the Golden Guard fully subsumed into Wruhec's Guardians, his leadership will be one of our most powerful tools."

287.speaker: Narrator
287.text: He lowered his voice even further.

288.speaker: Sal Ignacius
288.text: "Finally, Your Majesty... we will need to restructure the Royal Council under the guidance of the clergy."

292.speaker: Player_Romus
292.text: "I can't imagine a priest would know more about war and security than Duchess Azaro."

296.speaker: Narrator
296.text: He spoke in a mysterious tone.

297.speaker: Sal Ignacius
297.text: "The lady Azaro has a different role to play, Your Majesty. A far more important one."

298.speaker: Sal Ignacius
298.text: "The lady Azaro knows nothing of God, Your Majesty. I have seen it in her eyes."

302.speaker: Player_Romus
302.text: "Titus is religious. I should keep him on as security councilor."

303.speaker: Sal Ignacius
303.text: "He is needed as Captain of the Wruhec's Guardians, Your Majesty. The Council will be a distraction from that role."

304.speaker: Player_Romus
304.text: "The military wouldn't stand for it if I removed General Taddeus from the council."

305.speaker: Sal Ignacius
305.text: "Perhaps General Azaro will enjoy the chance to lead the military from his home province, without his council role to distract him."

306.speaker: Player_Romus
306.text: "I can't kick Elena and Laurento off the Royal Council. They've been there since I was a child."

307.speaker: Sal Ignacius
307.text: "Both Ms. Werner and Mr. Esquibel have led honorable lives in service to the crown. They have earned a happy retirement."

308.speaker: Player_Romus
308.text: "I can't imagine the House of Delegates would be happy with that change."

312.speaker: Sal Ignacius
312.text: "The Delegates' opinion is of no consequence. It never was."

313.speaker: Player_Romus
313.text: "Where will I find councilors with religious as well as state expertise? We can't reach Golconda if we tank the economy."

314.speaker: Sal Ignacius
314.text: "Don't you worry about that. The Lord will guide us forward."

315.speaker: Player_Romus
315.text: "At last. Sanctuary and state, working together as a single all-powerful apparatus."

317.speaker: Sal Ignacius
317.text: "When that time comes, I know you will choose wisely."

321.speaker: Sal Ignacius
321.text: "Their late leader has become a false saint. They're using his martyrdom as an excuse to wreak havoc."

322.speaker: Sal Ignacius
322.text: "Their leader is a false idol. His followers blindly worship him, though he is leading them nowhere."

326.speaker: Sal Ignacius
326.text: "It breaks my heart that Dastnurists and Golcondists are marching with the revolutionaries. They have abandoned their Nurist values."

330.speaker: Sal Ignacius
330.text: "It breaks my heart that Dastnurists are marching with the revolutionaries. They have abandoned their Nurist values."

334.speaker: Sal Ignacius
334.text: "It breaks my heart that Golcondists are marching with the revolutionaries. Proof at last that they were never true Wruhecists."

335.speaker: Narrator
335.text: Next to me, Sevrio serenely surveyed his army.

337.speaker: Narrator
337.text: He lowered his voice to an intense whisper.

344.speaker: Sal Ignacius
344.text: "With the sanctuaries you've built, the doctrine of Wruhecism has reached into every corner of our kingdom."

345.speaker: Sal Ignacius
345.text: "The university you sanctioned has created a new generation of learned men and women who will go forth and spread His will."
345.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Completed"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.WruhecistSanctuariesConstructed"] > 2) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true) == false)

346.speaker: Sal Ignacius
346.text: "A long time ago, I had a vision of Rizia's future. I believe it is finally about to come to life."

350.speaker: Sal Ignacius
350.text: "Our precious children are now being blessed with the wisdom of St. Wruhec before they even learn the alphabet."
350.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.WruhecistSanctuariesConstructed"] > 2) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true) == false)

354.speaker: Sal Ignacius
354.text: "With your government's encouragement, Wruhecist religious organizations are growing and flourishing."
354.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.WruhecistSanctuariesConstructed"] > 2) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_TaxCutsForReligiousOrgs"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true) == false)

355.speaker: Narrator
355.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.WruhecistSanctuariesConstructed"] > 2) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_TaxCutsForReligiousOrgs"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true) == false)

356.speaker: Sal Ignacius
356.text: "It is time, Your Majesty. Time for the old structures to crumble, and for the great golden pillar of Golconda to rise from the ruins."

357.speaker: Player_Romus
357.text: "I am ready, Grand Wiseman. Show me the way."

362.speaker: Player_Romus
362.text: "Are you trying to turn me on? Because it's working."

363.speaker: Sal Ignacius
363.text: "Earthly desire has no place in this. I am speaking of the full integration of Wruhecism into the Rizian government."

364.speaker: Player_Romus
364.text: "No, no... this is all too much. You're trying to turn Rizia into Derdia."

365.speaker: Narrator
365.text: The tone of his voice changed abruptly.

366.speaker: Sal Ignacius
366.text: "You should know better than that, Your Majesty. Derdia's theocracy relies on keeping followers in the dark. Ours will shine God's light upon all."

367.speaker: Player_Romus
367.text: "Tell me precisely what you have in mind."

368.speaker: Narrator
368.text: After the last cadet had sipped the water, Sevrio quietly approached Sal as well. The wiscerer whispered a benediction and gently raised the chalice to my guardsman's lips.

369.speaker: Narrator
369.text: After the last cadet had sipped the water, Sevrio quietly approached me as well.

373.speaker: Player_Romus
373.text: "God has big plans for you. Are you ready?"

374.speaker: Player_Romus
374.text: "In the name of St. Wruhec, I do bestow upon thee this holiest of blessings."

376.speaker: Player_Romus
376.text: "I hope you're proud of these graduates. May they serve the kingdom well."

378.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
378.text: "Ready as I can be, Your Majesty."

381.speaker: Narrator
381.text: I raised the chalice to my guardsman's lips.

382.speaker: Narrator
382.text: He drank, bathed in the kaleidoscopic light from the sanctuary's stained-glass windows.

383.speaker: Narrator
383.text: Captains Sevrio Castellanus and Titus Gordion walked in, their heads held high.

384.speaker: Narrator
384.text: They took their places on either side of Sal and myself as a continuous line of Wruhec's Guardian cadets began marching down the aisle.

386.speaker: Narrator
386.text: With another blast from the organ, the Wiseman finished his address. Sevrio stepped forward and began affixing star-shaped pins to each individual cadet's collar.
386.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PipelineNatDes_DeployWG"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.PipelineNatDes_DeployWG"] == true) == false)

387.speaker: Narrator
387.text: Sevrio leaned in and spoke in a hushed tone.

388.speaker: Narrator
388.text: As the ceremony continued, Sal turned to me once more.

389.speaker: Narrator
389.text: I had never felt so alive, so full of purpose. The time had come.

393.speaker: Narrator
393.text: I felt full of pride -- in the Guardians, and in myself for sending them out into the world.

394.speaker: Narrator
394.text: Sevrio leaned closer, lowering his voice to a whisper.
394.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PipelineNatDes_DeployWG"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.PipelineNatDes_DeployWG"] == true)

398.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
398.text: "Your Majesty, if I may speak freely -- I wanted to say how honored I am by the trust you've placed in the Wruhec’s Guardians to quell the civil unrest."

399.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
399.text: "My men are steadfast in their duty, not just to the realm, but to the divine order itself."

400.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
400.text: "To restore peace is to uphold the will of God."

401.speaker: Player_Romus
401.text: "You've handled yourselves admirably during these trying times, Sevrio. I expected nothing less."

402.speaker: Player_Romus
402.text: "Your devotion is commendable, but there is still much to be done. I trust the Wruhec's Guardians will see this through to the very end."

403.speaker: Player_Romus
403.text: "With righteousness on our side, there is no doubt that we will prevail."

404.speaker: Player_Romus
404.text: "Sacred or not, peace is won through strength and vigilance."

405.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
405.text: "My men remain sharp and unwavering in their duty -- we will not fail the kingdom."

406.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
406.text: "We stand ready for whatever lies ahead."

407.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
407.text: "Faith and steel will carry us to victory."

408.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
408.text: "Your confidence in us strengthens our resolve."

413.speaker: Sal Ignacius
413.text: "Your prohibition of heretic faiths has cleared the way for ours to flower."

417.speaker: Sal Ignacius
417.text: "Your Majesty... with the formation of the Guardians, we came one step closer to bringing God's will to Rizia. But I am afraid our goal of establishing a holy kingdom is still far out of reach."

418.speaker: Player_Romus
418.text: "Our goal? This was always your goal, Sal, not mine. I only founded the Guardians to keep the peace."

419.speaker: Sal Ignacius
419.text: "Hrm. That explains your cavalier treatment of the Wruhecist community since then."

420.speaker: Player_Romus
420.text: "Someday Rizia will rise to bask in God's glory."

421.speaker: Sal Ignacius
421.text: "Someday. When it has a king who prioritizes the Wruhecist congregation's needs."

422.speaker: Player_Romus
422.text: "What do you mean? Am I not the king from the prophesies?"

423.speaker: Sal Ignacius
423.text: "I once thought you might be. But then, I thought the same of your father..."

424.speaker: Sal Ignacius
424.text: "I'm not a young man, Your Majesty. Prophecies are as hard for me to read as newsprint."

425.speaker: Player_Romus
425.text: "I would love nothing more than to spend the rest of my reign promoting the tenets of Wruhecism. But alas, it's just not realistic."

426.speaker: Sal Ignacius
426.text: "I understand. I only entreat you not to take your faithful followers for granted."

430.speaker: Sal Ignacius
430.text: "As for the House of Delegates... I see no reason to alter its function."

431.speaker: Sal Ignacius
431.text: "Having a direct conduit to the people will be useful. So long as we ensure the representatives are faithful Wruhecists."

432.speaker: Sal Ignacius
432.text: "But as for the Royal Council... it will need to be restructured under the guidance of the clergy."

433.speaker: Narrator
433.text: He lowered his voice even further.

434.speaker: Narrator
434.text: The sanctuary choir broke into a jubilant-sounding hymnal, praising all who carry out the sacred duties of Nur.

435.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
435.text: "Repairing protester-damaged infrastructure, providing aid to displaced families, to name a few."

439.speaker: Sal Ignacius
439.text: "Thanks to the establishment of religious courts, divine judgment now walks beside the law of the land."
